confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by neighbourhood and season. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer price (roughly 2.8x and 3.2x beer), not direct knowledge. The KES exchange rate has moved over time, so USD figures may drift. The FX observation comes from an RBA overview page search snippet that I did not open directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Africa's capital and major tourist-facing cities with similar mid-range pricing, such as Kampala and Addis Ababa, adjusted for Nairobi's upscale restaurant scene and business-hotel supply. No specific named listings were consulted.
